BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Mosbrucker, Pettigrew, Harris, and Maycumber

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Housing, Community Development & Veterans.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Establishing a Travis alert outreach demonstration campaign.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a Travis alert outreach demonstration campaign; creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.

BillSectionHeader.P: (1) A Travis alert outreach demonstration campaign is created. By December 1, 2020, the Washington state military department, in coordination with local jurisdictions, shall initiate a demonstration campaign to increase awareness of the benefits and availability of making medical or disability information available to first responders in advance of an emergency. As part of the demonstration campaign, the Washington state military department shall provide appropriate outreach materials to two jurisdictions, one east of the crest of the Cascade mountains and one west of the crest of the Cascade mountains, capable of providing first responders with medical or disability information previously submitted.
